source: English patch v12 native scenario, item and invention tables; verified quest-milestone audit

semantics.snapshot: Facts describe one gameplay save, never combined across slots or prior snapshots.
semantics.unknown: null means unavailable or unverified; false means a readable supported record is absent.
semantics.manual: manualKey names a separate guide check; it never writes game data or supplies native history.
semantics.ownership: Current ordinary stock and key-item possession are distinct from acquisition and delivery.
semantics.lifecycle: No claim of preservation across New Game+ or a new-game reset.
